Featured Projects

Sell on FG

Role:UI Designer Timeline:1 week Team:1 designer
Landing Page Vendor Growth Responsive B2B Marketing

The Challenge

FashionGo needed to grow its vendor base by clearly communicating why brands should sell on the platform. The existing experience lacked a compelling, structured landing page that spoke directly to vendor pain points and highlighted FashionGo's unique advantages in the wholesale fashion market.

Figma ProtoPie Confluence
01

Desktop Experience

Designed a full-page vendor acquisition experience with a hero section, benefit highlights (reach 30k+ buyers, flexible payment terms, guaranteed wholesale), trust signals, and a vendor success section. The layout guides vendors through a clear value narrative from awareness to conversion.

02

Mobile Experience

Adapted the full desktop layout for mobile with a responsive single-column design. Key value propositions, vendor testimonials, and CTAs were prioritized for thumb-friendly navigation, ensuring a seamless experience for vendors browsing on the go.
